US and Iran hold technical talks mediated by Qatar

The United States and Iran have entered technical discussions aimed at securing a peace deal and potentially restarting shipping routes. These talks, facilitated by Qatar, involved U.S. officials meeting with Qatari leadership to prepare for negotiations. President Trump described the meetings as progressing well, despite acknowledging past actions against Iran.
